0.5.0-exp.1 — EXPERIMENTAL, for testing only. This build installs beside the beta as "AutoSpace Experimental" and never replaces it. Do not install it unless you were asked to test it.

## Improvements
- Startup is faster: the previous session's log tail and the private-profile wipe no longer run on the main thread at launch.
- The screen no longer stays on after a drive ends.
- The setup-guide words now name the place they actually open (AutoSpace's app settings on the phone).
- The color-scheme explainer now describes all eleven schemes.

## Bug fixes
No bug fixes.

## Maintenance
General maintenance and performance improvements.
